ONE STATE, THREE ROWS. Rule 2 (one colour for life) makes the Roman, Eastern Roman and Byzantine rows one continuous state: this dossier starts in 633 as a hand-over from eastern-roman-empire (a periodisation, confidence 1) and ends in 1460.
